fixtures.name: hsv-identity
fixtures.note: identity: no range adjustment, so the layer must not change a pixel

fixtures.name: hsv-master
fixtures.note: master range: +40 degrees, +60 saturation, -10 lightness

fixtures.name: hsv-reds
fixtures.note: targeted Reds range through hsvSettings; schema probe for the optional settings block

fixtures.name: levels-identity
fixtures.note: identity ranges: the macOS filter returns the image untouched

fixtures.name: levels-work
fixtures.note: composite range 20/1.4/230 with per-channel ranges on top

fixtures.name: levels-clip
fixtures.note: output ranges only: compresses the tonal range without moving the black point

fixtures.name: curves-identity
fixtures.note: two-point curves are the identity

fixtures.name: curves-s
fixtures.note: contrast S-curve on RGB plus separate red and green curves

fixtures.name: exposure-identity
fixtures.note: zero stops, no offset, gamma 1: the table is the identity

fixtures.name: exposure-up
fixtures.note: 0.8 stops of linear light, +0.05 offset, gamma 1.2

fixtures.name: gradientmap-default
fixtures.note: default black-to-white ramp: luminance picks the gray

fixtures.name: gradientmap-duotone
fixtures.note: duotone with reversed ends

fixtures.name: gradientmap-reversed-bw
fixtures.note: the same black-to-white ramp with reversed ends: probes whether the flag is read

fixtures.name: gradientmap-warm-end
fixtures.note: black to orange: probes whether the highlight color is read at all

fixtures.name: grain-default
fixtures.note: default grain at seed 12345

fixtures.name: grain-coarse
fixtures.note: strong, coarse, smooth grain: roughness 0 leaves the broad lattice alone

fixtures.name: addnoise-uniform
fixtures.note: uniform independent noise on each channel

fixtures.name: addnoise-gaussian-mono
fixtures.note: Gaussian noise, one value for all three channels

fixtures.name: gaussianblur-min
fixtures.note: minimum radius: sigma 0.1, effectively the identity

fixtures.name: gaussianblur-medium
fixtures.note: sigma 4 at 1:1; Core Image blurs past the edges into transparent black

fixtures.name: motionblur-min
fixtures.note: one pixel of streak: effectively the identity

fixtures.name: motionblur-30deg
fixtures.note: 9-pixel streak at +30 degrees; the sign of the angle is checked against both

fixtures.name: invert-chart
fixtures.note: every color becomes alpha minus color, alpha 255 everywhere

fixtures.name: invert-alpha
fixtures.note: invert on a canvas with partial alpha: the premultiplied path

fixtures.name: blackwhite-default
fixtures.note: Photoshop's default family weights

fixtures.name: blackwhite-tinted
fixtures.note: sepia tint at hue 40, saturation 60, with strong reds and greens

fixtures.name: colorbalance-identity
fixtures.note: all three wheels at zero: the macOS filter returns the image

fixtures.name: colorbalance-warm
fixtures.note: warm shadows and midtones, cooler highlights, luminosity preserved

fixtures.name: colorbalance-noluminosity
fixtures.note: the same shift without preserve luminosity, so brightness moves too

fixtures.name: control-base
fixtures.note: the chart with no adjustment layer: proves the base renders exactly

fixtures.name: control-identity-normal
fixtures.note: an identity adjustment layer above the chart must leave it alone

fixtures.name: effect-coloroverlay
fixtures.note: flat color through the shape at 60%: no blur anywhere, so formula-exact

fixtures.name: effect-stroke-outside
fixtures.note: outside stroke, 3 pixels of square dilation: formula-exact

fixtures.name: effect-stroke-inside
fixtures.note: inside stroke, 3 pixels of square erosion: formula-exact

fixtures.name: effect-shadow-hard
fixtures.note: drop shadow straight down 6 pixels with no blur: only the offset and the fill

fixtures.name: effect-shadow-ang180
fixtures.note: shadow at 180 degrees moves right with no blur: the horizontal offset and its sign

fixtures.name: effect-shadow-blur
fixtures.note: blurred drop shadow: sigma 3, so a different kernel shows as a soft difference

fixtures.name: effect-outerglow
fixtures.note: outer glow, sigma 3 all round minus the shape

fixtures.name: effect-innerglow
fixtures.note: inner glow: the shape less its own softening, all inside the shape

fixtures.name: effect-innershadow
fixtures.note: inner shadow in from the top edge, sigma 2

fixtures.name: effect-stack
fixtures.note: shadow, overlay and outside stroke together: checks the stacking order
